tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The page ground. Ink theme: near-black. Bone theme: the bone chapter ground. Every page and film frame starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panel: cards, inputs, chips, the menu sheet. On bone there is no raised surface; panels collapse to the ground and are framed by `border`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second raised step inside a panel (a table header, a nested well). Ink theme only.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover and selected ground one tonal step above `surface`. Ink theme only.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Selected chip or tab ground; the strongest tonal step before a border. Ink theme only.

tokens.name: diagnostics-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of diagnostic readouts and the DG32 fault-path plate.

tokens.name: evaluation-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of evaluation rows and per-route evaluation guides.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px frame of interactive panels, inputs and chips. 3:1 not required (decorative); never the only state cue.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between sections and rows. Translucent on ink. The site separates with rules, not boxes.

tokens.name: portfolio-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline inside the portfolio atlas rows.

tokens.name: portfolio-frame
tokens.usage: Frame of the portfolio workbench and atlas thumbnails.

tokens.name: strategy-rule
tokens.usage: Dashed frame of a proposed integration on strategy diagrams; also its label colour.

tokens.name: journey-rule
tokens.usage: Connector line of the route journey.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Body and heading text. On `ink`, `surface`, `muted`, `accent-surface`: 11.7:1 and above (15.7:1 on `ink`); bone 13.9:1. Bone: the bone ink.

tokens.name: paper-bright
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-surface` and the selected tab; the brightest text on ink.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, table cells, the storyboard body. On `ink` and `surface` (8.4:1 / 7.6:1); bone 6.7:1.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: footnotes and metadata on `ink` only (6.0:1). Not on `muted` or lighter.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Muted text: kickers, tagline lines, inactive tabs. On `ink`, `surface`, `muted`.

tokens.name: portfolio-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text in the v6 portfolio sections.

tokens.name: evaluation-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on `evaluation-surface`.

tokens.name: heading-em
tokens.usage: An emphasised phrase inside a serif h1 or h2 (upright, never italic).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: THE accent. Links, the primary button fill, the active tab's top border, the evidence-grade mark, a highlighted diagram block. One accent per view. Bone: bone copper (5.8:1 on bone).

tokens.name: copper-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid at 2-4px offset, never removed. Prefer this over `copper` for focus.

tokens.name: on-copper
tokens.usage: Text on a `copper` fill (the primary button). 8.3:1 on ink-theme copper; bone 5.8:1.

tokens.name: hardware
tokens.usage: Material colour of copper metal in renders and the opened package. Shading only, never text or UI.

tokens.name: cpu
tokens.usage: Teal: the SAFE state and nothing else (a latched-safe output, a passed gate). Never decoration, never a second accent. 5.7:1 on `ink`. On bone it is 2.7:1, under even the 3:1 mark floor: there, a safe state is a word in `paper` with a `cpu` fill behind it, never teal text or a teal-only mark.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Warm red-sand border on an invalid input, with the message beneath. Ink theme; on bone pair it with the message text in `paper`.

tokens.name: mark-ground
tokens.usage: Brand mark tile ground (favicon).

tokens.name: mark-copper
tokens.usage: Brand mark: the three copper squares.

tokens.name: mark-paper
tokens.usage: Brand mark: the offset fourth square.

families.mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: portfolio-display

styles.usage: Page headline on inner routes. Fluid: clamp(2.4rem, 3.8vw, 3.5rem).

styles.name: title

styles.name: portfolio-headline

styles.name: label

styles.name: portfolio-label

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything that takes a press: buttons, inputs, the menu button.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a portfolio section; 3rem below 800px (`section-y-phone`).

tokens.name: section-y-phone

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Brand-mark squares, evidence pips, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Primary button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The largest panels (the deck viewer, drawers).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Used twice on the site; do not add more. A document has no pill-shaped edges.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Status dots and diagram reading-path markers only.

shadow.note: Flat at rest. A shadow means the element floats (overlay) or answers a pointer (hover lift). Zero-offset halos are banned.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the deck viewer.

tokens.name: shadow-deep
tokens.usage: The largest floating surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-deepest
tokens.usage: A floating surface over busy media, where the page must recede.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on an interactive card.

tokens.name: shadow-hover-copper
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on the one copper-led card in a view.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum body text width at every viewport.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: page-wrap cap.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter; 5% below 650px (`gutter-phone`).

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Side gutter below 650px.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, solid `copper-ring`.
